title: SOC 2 Type II report
description: Service auditor's report with opinion, system description, tests and results for the stated period.

title: SOC 1 Type II report
description: SSAE 18 AT-C 320 report covering control objectives relevant to customer financial reporting.

title: Bridge letter
description: Management-signed letter covering report end date to requested date, stating material changes and known deficiencies.

title: Certification certificates and scope statements
description: Certificates with scope, issuing body and accreditation, if any are obtained.
notes: No certification is held or scheduled.

title: Independent penetration test attestation letter
description: Letter from an independent tester with identity, qualifications, dates, scope, severity counts and remediation status.

title: Continuous control evidence feed
description: Time-stamped, attributable, integrity-protected control run records with environment labels, including failures and missing heartbeats.
signing: Proposed: signed evidence per Secure Construction Standard

title: Assurance claim history and auditor peer review letter
description: Dated log of every public assurance statement and correction, plus the auditor's most recent AICPA peer review result.

title: Independent control sampling results
description: Semi-annual reviewer report on sampled control operation.
